4324-4828-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Benefactor's Draught is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
4324-4828-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
4324-4828-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Workshop Elders.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

5170-5256-6132-8175.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.

225-3227-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
225-3227-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Scrivener and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Scrivener and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers that many times.
Resolve a Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a land.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
Repeat steps 6 through 9 once.
Repeat from step 1.
225-3227-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Scrivener and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

240-1753-3899-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

277-3129-4772-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1651-7318-7824.description:
Activate Coin of Mastery by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens due to Bard.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the two tokens, untapping Coin of Mastery.
Repeat.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3388-3504.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3388-3504.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Moritte of the Frost and Mercurial Pretender each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Moritte of the Frost trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mercurial Pretender trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3388-3504.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1116-2946-4871-5686.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
1116-2946-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Sek'Kuar trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

129-969-1409-4289.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

338-6097-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-6097-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1137-2523-2869.description:
Activate Rith's Attendant by paying {1} and sacrificing it.
When Rith's Attendant dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Rith's Attendant that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat using the Rith's Attendant token

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-6972-7607.easyPrerequisites: There are at least one land card in all graveyards
997-6972-7607.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Centaur Vinecrasher.
When Centaur Vinecrasher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1473-3484-3490-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield.
1473-3484-3490-7426.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield.
Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Fabrication Module triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat from step 3.

3490-3698-4455-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
3490-3698-4455-7426.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ghost Lantern triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1
Repeat

4050-6741-7282.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five multicolored permanents.
4050-6741-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Infinite Guideline Station that is a 1/1 Soldier.
Put the Infinite Guideline Station token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Infinite Guideline Station token enters, it triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Robot artifact creature token for each multicolored permanent you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar five times by sacrificing five Robots, adding {5}.
Repeat.

1052-3175-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

789-5686-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
789-5686-7084.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Gutter Grime and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.
789-5686-7084.notes: As Gutter Grime will get more and more slime counters, the final token you make will be infinitely large.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4871-5220-5686-6594.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-5686-6594.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

967-1292-3117-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and putting Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Jace's Erasure triggers, causing you to mill Sensei's Divining Top.
When Sensei's Divining Top is milled, Grolnok triggers, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with a croak counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

14-141-3967.description:
Cast Reincarnation by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Reincarnation, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Reincarnation.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Reincarnation triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities from step 5.

1808-6291-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature you control.
Eloise's first ability triggers, and Eloise's second ability triggers if the creature was a token.
Resolve the first trigger, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, if applicable, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

945-1303-2034.description:
Cast Relentless Dead by paying {B}{B}.
When Relentless Dead enters the battlefield, Necroduality triggers, creating a token copy of it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Relentless Dead, adding {C}{C}.
When Relentless Dead dies, its first and second abilities trigger. Choose not to pay for either.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the token Relentless Dead, adding {C}{C}.
When the token Relentless Dead dies, its first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to pay {2} to return Relentless Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1548-3609-6750.notablePrerequisites:
Port Razer cannot be blocked by an opponent.
Inspirit has one or more charge counters on it.
1548-3609-6750.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Inspirit triggers, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Port Razer, triggering its ability, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your second combat phase. At the beginning of the combat phase, Inspirit triggers, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2525-3358-4785.description:
During your upkeep, activate Hell's Caretaker by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Hell's Caretaker.
Activate Body Double by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Hell's Caretaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4871-6291-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat

1563-2457-4365-6633.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

586-2292-4924-5258-5618.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4067-4306-4477-6281.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Greenwarden of Murasa.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Greenwarden of Murasa from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.

1242-3990-4613.manaNeeded: {3}{G}{G} minus {1}{G}{G} for each +1/+1 counter on Incubation Druid
1242-3990-4613.description:
If Incubation Druid does not have a +1/+1 counter on it, activate its adapt ability by paying {3}{G}{G}, putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Incubation Druid using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Incubation Druid.
Repeat.

3812-5457-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
3812-5457-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Selvala's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

880-4677-4826.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4677-4826.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When the land enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1170-2733-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {U}{U}.
1170-2733-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Palinchron.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Archfiend of Despair

2607-2682-4284.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2607-2682-4284.description:
Cast Dire Fleet Ravager by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Dire Fleet Ravager enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to lose a third of their life total, rounded up.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Archfiend of Despair and Clone trigger.
Resolve the Archfiend of Despair trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Resolve the Clone trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life they lost this turn.
Each opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

678-1636-3661-5098.notablePrerequisites: Grima Wormtongue does not have summoning sickness.
678-1636-3661-5098.description:
Activate Grima Wormtongue by tapping it and sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Grima Wormtongue ability, causing target player to lose 1 life.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.

771-1692-2493-4886.notablePrerequisites:
Wildfire Eternal does not have summoning sickness.
Helm of the Host attached to Archaeomancer.
An opponent cannot block Wildfire Eternal.
771-1692-2493-4886.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer with haste.
When the token Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Savage Beating to your hand from your graveyard.
Declare Wildfire Eternal as an attacker.
When Wildfire Eternal is not blocked, it triggers, casting Savage Beating from your hand without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Savage Beating, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1895-2493-2562-4050.description:
Cast Graceful Reprieve by paying {W}, targeting Archaeomancer.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Archaeomancer, adding {W}.
When Archaeomancer dies, Graceful Reprieve triggers, returning Archaeomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Graceful Reprieve from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
